rules.name: Single Definition Authority
rules.rule: Every field-level fact has exactly one machine-readable authority artifact. Human documents may not create a second current-looking schema.

rules.name: Identifier Stability
rules.rule: Published subject, context, metric definition, release, episode and stage identities are immutable; correction is by supersession/versioning.

rules.name: Session Time
rules.rule: Computation uses authoritative Session Time; source clocks require explicit TimeTransform; JS-visible int64 time transports as decimal string.

rules.name: Half-open Interval
rules.rule: All windows use [start,end); gaps, validity, source/clock/configuration boundaries split windows.

rules.name: Missing Is Not Zero
rules.rule: Missing prerequisite data yields N_A or INSUFFICIENT_DATA with reason code; never fabricate zero.

rules.name: Context Immutability
rules.rule: Historical computation/read uses exact immutable context_id and exact bound artifacts; no current/latest fallback.

rules.name: Release Immutability
rules.rule: Published result is release-bound; historical replay resolves immutable definition/catalog/context/world/evidence provenance.

rules.name: Typed Metric Value
rules.rule: value_kind determines one legal value slot; STRUCTURED is object and binds exactly one executable structured schema.

rules.name: Stable Subjects
rules.rule: P1 primary subjects are AIRCRAFT and MISSION_SYSTEM_INSTANCE; TARGET_PAIR is reference/evaluation quality only and never a longitudinal subject.

rules.name: Observation Lanes
rules.rule: AIRCRAFT_CAP_L1_OBSERVATION, SYSTEM_PERFORMANCE_OBSERVATION and QUALITY_EVIDENCE_ONLY are mutually governed publication lanes.

rules.name: Longitudinal Compatibility
rules.rule: Only trend-eligible NUMERIC metrics enter numeric longitudinal_sample; comparison keys segment semantic/configuration/profile changes.

rules.name: No Future Leakage
rules.rule: As-of joins are causal; state/config uses backward validity, command-response uses forward causal windows, and nearest is only explicit-policy.

rules.name: Evidence First
rules.rule: Every metric/observation/assessment must retain evidence and provenance anchors sufficient for deterministic drill-down.

rules.name: Safety Boundary
rules.rule: System does not derive weapon performance envelopes, best launch/release geometry, probability-of-kill models, tactical optimization or combat recommendations.

rules.name: Change Closure
rules.rule: Authority artifact + dependent contracts + migrations + fixtures + traceability + validators change atomically; otherwise baseline build fails.

rules.name: Semantic Product Separation
rules.rule: Canonical facts, World products, Metric/Observation, Assessment, adjusted/capability Estimate, and Forecast/Counterfactual are distinct product classes. A downstream interpretation never rewrites an upstream fact.

rules.name: Scope Separation
rules.rule: Individual, Team, Package/Mission and Joint/LVC scopes remain explicit. Team/mission results are not copied to individual actors; individual scores are not averaged to manufacture team capability.

rules.name: World Capability Gate
rules.rule: Permissible conclusions are gated by declared C/W/P/A/J/M availability and quality. Truth never substitutes for observer perception and missing adjudication never becomes an inferred official outcome.

rules.name: Instructor Revision Integrity
rules.rule: Instructor annotation/override is revisioned and preserves the original automatic product, reviewer identity, reason and rubric/profile version. Human review does not mutate immutable Metric/World facts.

rules.name: Attribution Identifiability
rules.rule: P2+ attribution may return NOT_IDENTIFIABLE/INSUFFICIENT_DATA. Factor effects are model-conditioned associations by default and are not personnel blame, fault diagnosis or causal proof.

rules.name: Cohort Comparability
rules.rule: Longitudinal comparisons require an explicit cohort/comparison key covering material subject, configuration, scenario, role/team, world-capability and algorithm/profile semantics. Incomparable points are segmented rather than joined.

rules.name: Knowledge-Time Integrity
rules.rule: When later information changes interpretation, the system distinguishes original as-known replay from retrospective revision. Backfilled labels/configuration do not masquerade as contemporaneous knowledge.

rules.name: Evidence Independence
rules.rule: Record count, observation count, independent subject count and effective evidence volume are distinct. Deduplication or multiple sources do not by themselves prove statistical independence.

rules.name: Dormant Future Contracts
rules.rule: P2-P6 contracts may be frozen before implementation, but UI/API must feature-gate them and may not present unimplemented/unvalidated capability as available.

rules.name: External Interoperability Boundary
rules.rule: TENA/HLA/DIS or other external protocols enter through governed adapters/gateways and Canonical/World contracts; core assessment logic does not depend on a transport protocol.

rules.name: Training Plugin Composition
rules.rule: New training types compose Context, World policy, Stage/Objectives, Event/Relation, Metric and Assessment contracts; plugins may not bypass the C+TPAA-M evidence spine or create source-specific business logic above reconstruction.

rules.name: Platform-Neutral Business Core
rules.rule: Windows and Linux are mandatory supported OS families. Domain, Application, reconstruction, Stage/Event, Metric, Assessment, Longitudinal, Capability and Release semantics shall not branch by OS; platform differences are isolated behind explicit adapters.

rules.name: Cross-Platform Logical Equivalence
rules.rule: The same frozen input and governed versions shall produce equivalent logical products on Windows and Linux: discrete identities/status/stages/events are exact and numeric results satisfy the same governed Golden tolerance/rounding policy. OS-local paths, PIDs and package bytes are not business semantics.

rules.name: Controlled Progress/Layer Vocabulary
rules.rule: Project progress/layer vocabulary is restricted to P (Capability Phase), M (Development Milestone), WS (Engineering Workstream) and Episode Stage. Generic or alternate phase/stage numbering shall not create a fifth progress namespace.

rules.name: P/M/WS/Stage Orthogonality
rules.rule: P describes capability claim depth, M describes project acceptance progress, WS organizes engineering work, and Stage describes training/Episode process. Completion or renaming in one namespace never changes semantic identity in another.

rules.name: Metric Family Applicability and Product-Layer Separation
rules.rule: P1 metric families shall be applied only to their governed subject/product layer. In particular P1-SNS-* is the RADAR sensor detection/measurement family and is not a generic all-sensor family; passive IRST/EO, RWR/ESM, DATALINK and FUSION use their dedicated families. Local track and association/identification metrics are product-layer evaluations and shall not be substituted for raw sensor-measurement metrics.
